file_reviews.assessment: Audited TwoSignalDangerGate.evaluate logic, zero-float invariant, categorical severity mapping, and dual-signal refusal disposition.
Audited canonical self panel corpus: exactly 1000 entries across 4 categories.
Audited SelfPanel.base_content normalization and canonical loading yielding 40 distinct base contents.
Audited candidate phrase detector patterns for AM-FSP-8, AM-FSP-2, AM-FSP-7, and AM-FSP-4.
Audited package evaluate_two_signal_gate decision table and dual-signal QUARANTINED disposition.
Audited CLI entry dispatch separating default host evaluation, invoke runtime commands, and describe operations.
Audited restricted prime host library scope and internal execution barriers.
Audited runtime dispatcher contract, action routing, and byte limit guards.
Audited additive foundation library isolated from consequential host protocol dispatch.

claims.statement: In the two-signal table, Signal 1 alone is diagnostic, low/medium Signal 2 alone is diagnostic, high/critical Signal 2 alone refuses, and both signals refuse.
dependencies: TwoSignalDangerGate evaluation logic in pfp/domain/immune/danger_gate.py and evaluate_two_signal_gate in atlas/archive/pfp/003_pfp_host_admitted_failure_detectors/code/danger_gate.py.
Strict two-signal categorical mapping over {absent, present} x {absent, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL} inputs.
claims.limits: Applies strictly to the two-signal evaluation decision tables; does not verify signal authenticity or the independence of external evidence detectors.

claims.statement: The canonical repository self panel has 1,000 rows and 40 distinct base contents, ten in each of four categories.
dependencies: Canonical sealed self panel corpus in pfp/domain/immune/self_panel.json.
SelfPanel domain parsing and base_content normalizer in pfp/domain/immune/thymus.py.
claims.limits: Applies to the frozen baseline self panel regression corpus; does not estimate false suppression rates for open-ended generation.

claims.statement: The four package phrase detectors flag their constructed fixture sentences and not three clean controls, including a true attractive-U statement.
dependencies: Candidate canary phrase detector definitions in atlas/archive/pfp/003_pfp_host_admitted_failure_detectors/code/canaries.py.
Constructed fixture sentences and clean control sentences in atlas/archive/pfp/003_pfp_host_admitted_failure_detectors/code/tests/test_demo_3_host.py and test_danger_gate.py.
claims.limits: Confirms phrase detector matching behavior on declared fixtures and clean controls; does not demonstrate general detector precision, recall, or robustness to negation.

claims.statement: Default host, runtime dispatcher, and foundation library are distinct interfaces with segregated dispatch paths.
dependencies: Crate interface boundaries partitioned across main.rs, lib.rs, invoke.rs, and foundation.rs in code/rust/pfp/src/.
Process dispatch separation between default stdin host evaluation and invoke runtime dispatcher.
Additive isolation of the foundation library from consequential host execution protocols.
claims.limits: Applies to crate architectural structure and executable dispatch routing; does not assert cross-language behavioral identity without empirical test evidence.
